# Ditectrev

> Information Technology (IT) services company focused on consulting and online education in cyber security, digital strategy, and software development.

Ditectrev was founded in 2017 as a consulting company and in 2022 is transforming towards online education. Combined with IT consulting, the aim is a unique mix for students to grow and use gained knowledge in commercial projects, including e-learning boot camps, courses, exam preparations, and open source projects around Cyber Security, Digital Strategy, and Software Development.

The company is registered in Poland as IBStructure Daniel Danielecki, Irysowa 18, 55-220 Jelcz-Laskowice, tax ID PL9121899240. Work is fully remote from different countries. It is a small company. Contact: contact@ditectrev.com, +48 732 280 741.

Delivery uses an agile Scrum process with frequent client updates. Online courses are published on Udemy and partially on YouTube (Freemium). Educational content also appears on a free blog. Do not disclose information from commercial projects.

For a longer citation-friendly fact sheet and Q&A, see [llms-full.txt](https://ditectrev.com/llms-full.txt).
